findings.description: Multiple threads may write to `*d_found` simultaneously without synchronization.
The code does not check if `mid` (or `start`/`end`) exceeds the bounds of the allocated array.
`d_found` is not initialized to `false` before the kernel runs.
Calculation of `start`, `end`, and `mid` could overflow if `threadId` or `segment_size` is large.
